scope: Read-only product-source diagnosis; owned non-GUI fixture apps and evidence only.

formatterFinding.cause: Managed scratch is inside the primary repository's ignored /.keld-work/ tree. Bun fmt honors ancestor Git ignore rules, selects no source files, exits 0 and leaves deliberately unformatted source unchanged.
formatterFinding.reproduction: Same actual built keld.exe create command, same package, same Bun binary and same unformatted bytes in both apps.

samePathControl.onlyChange: git init --quiet --template= in the owned disposable managed app
samePathControl.diagnosis: A local repository boundary removes the ancestor ignore rule and restores rejection without changing Bun, package scripts, PATH or source bytes.

formatterFinding.limitations: Full original Rust test was not rerun here; root's full-workspace run remained the sole Cargo/nextest owner. Comparison with lead's earlier pass was not independently inspected.

evidence: tools/workspace.py Context.root: self.primary / DIRECTORY; DIRECTORY is .keld-work.
allocate_scratch: parent = safe_path(ctx.root / 'tmp'); no alternate root argument.
run: child_env overwrites TMPDIR, TEMP and TMP with the allocated scratch.
safe_path rejects symlink/reparse ancestors; context rejects Git directory override variables.
docs/onboarding/05-development-guide.md Local agent workspace documents only primary/.keld-work/tmp/<short-token>.
.agents/coordination.md assigns session scratch/log ownership to work-run.
managedScratchRelocation.blocker: The D: primary cannot select an independent managed C: scratch root using any current supported CLI option or environment setting.
managedScratchRelocation.updaterContext: Root reports existing updater guard refusals: volume anchor grants mutation to S-1-5-11. This subtask did not reproduce updater tests or alter ACLs.
managedScratchRelocation.nextAction: Keep baseline failures visible and choose a separately owned workspace change supporting qualified external scratch, or another approved environment. Do not use ACL weakening, junctions, or hidden TEMP overrides as a pass.
separateAcceptanceChecks: Formatter: planted source is discovered, check exits 1 without changing bytes, repair changes bytes, next check exits 0.
Updater: actual selected volume and ancestor ACLs satisfy existing production guard unchanged.
Managed workspace: allocated external scratch, if added by its owner, retains session identity, path qualification, custody and cleanup evidence.
managedScratchRelocation.caveat: A real C: primary would still use ignored .keld-work scratch, so it does not alone resolve formatter discovery. A C: linked worktree attached to the D: primary still gets D: scratch.
